sources: https://cityofyatescenter.com/lakes/ (read 2026-11-06 by plain HTTP; undated page): 'South Owl Lake has approximately 276 acres of surface water'; 'THE CITY OF YATES CENTER HAS TWO RV PARKS. YATES CENTER RV PARK IS LOCATED ON HWY 75 & 105TH ROAD. SOUTH OWL LAKE RV PARK IS LOCATED AT SOUTH OWL LAKE. (FROM HWY 75 TURN WEST ON 105TH AND FOLLOW THE ROAD APPROXIMATELY 1/2 MILE). BOTH HAVE ELECTRIC AND WATER HOOKUPS. SEWER HOOKUP AVAILABLE AT SOUTH OWL LAKE RV PARK ONLY. DUMP STATION ONLY AT YATES CENTER RV PARK. $20.00 PER NIGHT ($25.00 FOR FIRST NIGHT IF RESERVED). FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION CONTACT CITY HALL 620-625-2118.'

RV Life park 249910 'South Owl RV Park' (city, 4.5 stars / 12 ratings, price_level 1) reviews https://campgrounds.rvlife.com/api/reviews/park/249910 (read 2026-11-06): paid $15 in 10/2026 (site 1, pull-through, power/water/sewer), $10 in 4/2026 ('Water, electricity, sewer, wifi, pull thru ... Great spot for 10$'), $15 in 5/2025 ('9 sites available. 30/50 amp, water and sewer'), 6/2024 ('electric and water for only $10 on a first-come basis, or $15 if you call and make a reservation ... the first site which is for 30 amp RV's').

Esri World Imagery 2026-11-06 (700 m and 220 m frames): the RV park is one gravel strip of pull-throughs inside the upper loop road north-east of the lake, centred ~37.86825,-95.7448, RVs on it; between it and the water lie the lower loop road, a shelter house and day-use lawn with trees; nearest water (the north-east corner of the lake by the fishing pier / top of the east dam) is ~150 m south-west of the strip.

summary: City page (undated, live 2026-11-06) confirms $20/night ($25 first night reserved), electric+water+sewer, no dump (dump at Yates Center RV Park), reservable via City Hall. Amperage 30/50 from a 2025 camper. Not waterfront confirmed (~150 m from water behind the lower loop road and day-use area).
flags: RATE CONFLICT (no edit beyond the city's figure): the city page says $20 a night ($25 first night if reserved), but RV Life campers paid $15 in 10/2026, $10 in 4/2026, $15 in 5/2025, and in 6/2024 reported '$10 first-come, $15 reserved'. The page is undated and may be stale (Wayback captures 2026-03-07 .. 2026-07-07 exist). Stored $20-25 kept as the operator's posted figure; a call to City Hall 620-625-2118 would settle it.
COUNT: not written (brief). RV Life camper 5/2025 says '9 sites available'; imagery shows one strip of roughly 6-9 pull-throughs.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. Single row/strip of sites, centred ~37.86825,-95.7448, ~150 m from the nearest water (lake's north-east corner by the pier and the top of the east dam), with the lower loop road, shelter house, day-use lawn and trees between. No row is within lakeview range with open ground. A 2026-04 camper wrote 'pull thru by water', which reads as the lake nearby, not on it. Lake is 276 acres, so not a pond.
PIN: stored 37.8685,-95.74388 sits at the loop-road junction ~85 m east of the site strip; under 250 m, fine (optional nudge to 37.86825,-95.7448).
Phone 620-625-2118 (City Hall) confirmed on the city page. Website https://cityofyatescenter.com/lakes/ confirmed.

ADD LEAD: Yates Center RV Park (city of Yates Center, US-75 & 105th Road, electric + water hookups, the city dump station, same $20/$25 rate and City Hall 620-625-2118 per https://cityofyatescenter.com/lakes/) is NOT in the DB (nothing else within ~6 km but 2236 Still Waters Edge Retreat).
